description: This file defines a module for generating chart themes that are aware of dark mode settings. It includes functions to read CSS variables, convert hex colors to RGBA, and assemble a theme object with color tokens sourced from CSS variables or fallback theme tokens.

methods.name: getCssVar
methods.description: Reads a CSS variable from the :root element, returning a fallback if unavailable or on error.

methods.name: withAlpha
methods.description: Converts a hex color string to an RGBA string with specified alpha transparency, with fallback on failure.
